Whether the braking-box endpoint speed falls below the 0.02 m/s settling speed limit over this one 0.01 s step.
Endpoint position shift between the two arms, to check the braking box is not merely trading speed reduction for a large position penalty.
hypotheses: H1_unused_local_braking: the recorded applied input for update 32 leaves locally available braking authority unused, so the braking-box input yields a materially lower projected endpoint tip speed at this saved state.

H2_locally_bounded_braking: braking authority at this saved state is locally bounded (per-tendon force limits, geometry, or projected-model limits), so the braking-box input yields an endpoint tip speed close to the recorded input's.

H3_same_local_endpoint_from_different_mechanisms: if the two endpoints differ, objective weighting (terminal/holding tip-speed weights recorded as 0.0) and solver early-stop plan quality both predict the same local outcome and cannot be separated by this probe.
